name: IL-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Jonathan Jackson running for reelection
model.rationale: The D+18 district, an incumbent with a large fundraising edge, and no serious outside spending all point to a comfortable Jackson win; Polymarket prices him around 95%. With no polls or expert ratings, uncertainty stays elevated but the fundamentals leave little doubt.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a single-digit race or major outside spending against Jackson would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Jonathan Jackson, the Democratic incumbent in this Chicago-based district, is favored to win a second full term. The seat leans heavily Democratic, with a partisan advantage of about 18 points, and Jackson has raised roughly $418,000 to Republican Christian Maxwell's $63,000. No outside groups are active in the race, and no expert raters list it as competitive.

Prediction markets give Jackson about a 95% chance of winning, and the fundamentals point to a margin in the low-to-mid 20s. With no public polling available, the forecast relies on district lean, incumbency, and the money gap, all of which favor Jackson decisively.
